topics.description: A recent report revealed that poor policy language may have cost $1.7B across 14 Medicaid services in Minnesota. This has sparked concern and calls for policy tweaks to recover millions.
topics.reason: High financial impact and potential for recovery of funds

topics.description: A federal judge has ordered the Trump administration to restore funding for the Gateway Tunnel Project between New York and New Jersey. This decision has significant implications for infrastructure projects.
topics.reason: High-profile infrastructure project funding at risk
